title: Confirm assumptions and finalize allocation

assumptions.currency: USD assets acceptable; HKD/USD peg limits FX risk
assumptions.access: US broker; ETF-based, no stock picking
assumptions.constraints: no ESG exclusions, no leverage, no crypto

rationale: Long 10+ year horizon supports high equity weight
Moderately aggressive tolerance supports 85/15 split and growth tilt
Low-cost ETFs match client preference and reduce fee drag
trade_offs: Higher equity weight raises expected return but larger drawdowns (~30-40%)
Growth/tech tilt raises return but increases concentration/volatility
International sleeves add diversification but currency/geopolitical risk
Bond sleeve reduces volatility but caps bull-market upside
No leverage/crypto bounds risk but forgoes higher-risk options
limitations: Simulated proposal, not personalized financial advice. ETF tickers illustrative. No live market data fetched in this task.
